recipes.title: Carne con Chile y Papas

items.i: thin-sliced lean beef (sirloin or milanesa), cut in strips

steps: In a lightly oiled pan, blister the tomatoes, chiles, onion and garlic until charred in spots.
Blend the charred vegetables with the water and bouillon until smooth.
Season the beef strips and brown them in the pan with just a little oil, then add the sliced onion.
Pour the chile sauce over the beef, add the diced potatoes and simmer, covered, until the potatoes are tender and the sauce thickens (about 20 minutes).
Serve with Mexican rice and warm tortillas.
recipes.notes: The video doesn't give amounts — quantities and macros (per serving, without rice or tortillas) are estimates from what's shown. Use little oil, as she suggests, to keep it light.
